hypothesis: The useful re-entry frontier interfaces with the old target-narrowing frontier only through exact equality replacement at bare-variable positions that the frozen overlap heuristic suppresses.

rivals.R1: Variable-position overlap involving the nine re-entry edges creates a component join or replayable closure while matched old-old variable overlap does not.
rivals.R2: Variable-position overlap is generically sufficient on the old frontier; re-entry is not causal.
rivals.R3: Even variable-position overlap produces no bridge; the missing composition object is deeper than the current term-position grammar.

soundness_boundary: Only exact endpoint equality replacement is allowed. No unification, no variable instantiation beyond the already replayable equality nodes, and every produced DAG must pass replay_dag before counting as closure.

decision_rule.R1_VARIABLE_INTERFACE_CAUSAL: Re-entry-conditioned variable overlap joins/closes while matched old-old variable overlap does not.
decision_rule.MEASUREMENT_FAILURE: Parent facts or replay/soundness checks fail to reproduce.
